recipes.name: Deep Fried Burger Bomb
ingredients: 2 pounds chuck roast, boneless short ribs, or ribeye, cut into 1 inch cubes
freshly ground black pepper, to taste
For the Short Rib Bones Snack
instructions: For Deep Fried Burger Bomb:
For the Burger Patties

Line a sheet tray with parchment paper. Add the cubed beef and spread into one even layer. Freeze for 20-30 minutes, or until the beef is firm to the touch, partially frozen, but not completely frozen, about 80%. - 2 pounds chuck roast boneless short ribs, or ribeye, cut into 1 inch cubes
For the Cheese Sauce
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the sharp cheddar cheese with the cornstarch. Transfer to a small saucepan. - 8 oz sharp cheddar cheese grated - 1 tbsp cornstarch
Then add evaporated milk. Mix until combined and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it has thickened into a pourable cheese sauce consistency. - 1 (5 oz) can evaporated milk
Set aside and keep warm. - For the Cheese Sauce
For the Burgers
After the beef is firm to the touch, transfer to a food processor and pulse until the beef is the size of small pebbles. - 2 pounds chuck roast boneless short ribs, or ribeye, cut into 1 inch cubes
Divide the meat into about 6 equal patties, each weighing about 6 ounces/170 grams, and transfer back to the lined sheet tray. - For the Burger Patties
Refrigerate until ready to use. - For the Burger Patties
Preheat a cast iron skillet or flat top griddle to medium high.
Remove the burgers from the refrigerator and season both sides with salt and pepper. - For the Burger Patties - kosher salt to taste - freshly ground black pepper to taste
Transfer patties to the griddle and cook for 3 minutes, or until the burger is deeply golden brown. - For the Burger Patties
Flip each patty, then add 2 pieces of American cheese to each patty. - 2 pieces American cheese - For the Burger Patties
While the cheese is melting, add the top and bottom of the buns to the griddle. Toast for 2-3 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown. - 3 sesame seed buns
Transfer the toasted buns to a clean work surface and top both sides with mayonnaise. - mayonnaise - 3 sesame seed buns
Add a small handful of sliced iceberg lettuce to the bottom bun, followed by a tbsp of chopped onion. - iceberg lettuce thinly sliced - 1 tbsp chopped red onion
Top the onions with 2 burger patties per bun, then top with 2 pickles. Set aside. - 2 crinkle cut dill pickles - For the Burger Patties - 3 sesame seed buns
Repeat with all patties then wrap the assmbled burgers in plastic wrap and refrigerate while you set up your deep-frying station. - For the Burger Patties - For the Burgers
For the Deep-Frying
For the Wet Dredge
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, flour and water until fully homogeneous. Set aside. - 2 large eggs - 2 cups flour - 1 cup water
For the Dry Dredge

In another medium mixing bowl, add the panko, sesame seeds and black pepper. Toss gently with your hands to combine, then set aside. - 4 cups panko bread crumbs - 1 tbsp sesame seeds - 1 tsp black pepper
Fill a Dutch oven with 3 inches of oil. Preheat over medium heat until it reaches 375°F. - vegetable oil for frying
Once the oil has come to temperature, move the burger to the dredging station. Add it to the wet dredge, turning it to fully coat. - Wet Dredge - For the Burgers
Then transfer to the dry dredge and fully cover it in the seasoned panko bread crumbs. - For the Dry Dredge - For the Burgers

Using a spider, carefully transfer into the hot oil. Keep the burger until the oil by pressing down with the spider while it fries. Fry until the outside is deeply golden brown. - Assembled Burgers - vegetable oil for frying
Transfer to a paper towel lined sheet tray and allow to cool for several minutes. - For the Burgers
While the burger is cooling, reheat the cheese sauce over medium heat. Once the sauce begins lightly bubbling, remove from the heat. - For the Cheese Sauce
Slice the burger in half and pour the cheese sauce over top. Serve immediately. - For the Burgers - For the Cheese Sauce
For Leftovers:
For the Short Rib Bones Snack
Roast in the oven at 375°F for about 30 minutes. - leftover short rib bones
Once finished roasting, remove as much of the meat from the bones as you can, then transfer to a medium sauté pan with mirin, soy sauce, and vinegar. - 1 tsp mirin - 1 tsp soy sauce - 1 tsp vinegar
Reduce and toss over medium heat until sticky and fragrant.
Enjoy as a snack!
For the Cheesy Biscuits Snack
Combine the leftover wet dredge, dry dredge, and cheese sauce in a large mixing bowl. - leftover wet dredge - leftover dry dredge - leftover cheese sauce

Chop cheese slices into small pieces and add to the leftovers mixture. Combine, then dollop golf-ball-sized pieces of dough onto parchment-lined baking sheets. - cheese slices chopped - For the Cheese Dough Balls
Bake in the oven at 400°F until crispy. - For the Cheese Dough Balls
Serve fresh out of the oven with a sauce of your choosing!
